name: verify_accountPaymentTerm_audit_columns_by_id
note: account_payment_term: create/write uid and date per row (mail/chatter and the record's metadata read), keyed by id
source_sql: SELECT id, create_uid, write_uid, create_date, write_date FROM account_payment_term ORDER BY id

name: verify_accountPaymentTerm_scalar_listing
note: account_payment_term: every int/string/bool column of every row as a list view reads it, keyed by id
source_sql: SELECT id, company_id, sequence, discount_days, early_pay_discount_computation, active, display_on_invoice, early_discount FROM account_payment_term ORDER BY id

name: verify_accountPaymentTerm_embed_fanout_by_parent
note: account_payment_term: per-parent count of each embedded array (account_payment_term_line) against the child-row count, keyed by id
source_sql: SELECT r.id, COALESCE(e0.n, 0) AS n_line FROM account_payment_term r LEFT JOIN (SELECT payment_id AS pid, COUNT(*) AS n FROM account_payment_term_line GROUP BY payment_id) e0 ON e0.pid = r.id ORDER BY r.id
